overview.name: Tradr 2X Long CIEN Daily ETF
overview.description: Under normal market circumstances, the fund manager will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the daily performance of CIEN. CIEN is a network technology company that provides hardware, software, and services to a wide range of network operators and enables enhanced network capacity, service delivery, and automation. The fund is non-diversified.
